paper_title: PELMS Pre-training for Effective Low-Shot Multi-Document Summarization
caption: Low-shot pre-trained model performance on the multi-document summarization (MDS) task with ROUGE-G scores (geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L) aggregated over 6 MDS benchmarks. We compare with fully-supervised training (solid lines) and with adapter training (dashed lines) where only 5% of model parameters are tuned. achieves stronger overall performance at all data quantities and training methods when compared to competitive long-input summarization models.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the overall ROUGE-G score achieved by various models across different numbers of training examples. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples" and displays tick marks at specific values of 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with horizontal gridlines and tick labels plotted at intervals of 2.0. The plot contains eight lines distinguished by color, marker shape, and line style to represent different model configurations. The PELMS line is a solid green line with circular markers; it starts at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 16.7, increases to roughly 18.4 at x=16, and ends at approximately 18.7 at x=64. The PELMS (5%) line is a dashed green line with circular markers; it begins at x=0 and y≈16.7, rises slightly to roughly 17.0 at x=16, and finishes at approximately 17.9 at x=64. The Primera line is a solid red line with square markers, starting at roughly 15.0 at x=0, increasing to approximately 17.2 at x=16, and reaching roughly 18.2 at x=64. The Primera (5%) line is a dashed red line with square markers, which begins at approximately 15.0 at x=0, experiences a slight decline to roughly 14.6 at x=16, and then rises to end at approximately 15.9 at x=64. The Pegasus-X line is a solid blue line with upward-pointing triangular markers; it starts at x=0 with a y-value of roughly 13.6, climbs to about 15.5 at x=16, and ends at approximately 17.9 at x=64. The Pegasus-X (5%) line is a dashed blue line with upward-pointing triangular markers, starting at roughly 13.6 at x=0, dropping to a low point of approximately 11.6 at x=16, and then rising to roughly 14.1 at x=64. The Centrum line is a solid yellow line with diamond markers, starting at x=0 and y≈15.8, showing a very slight increase to roughly 16.0 at x=16, and ending at approximately 16.4 at x=64. Finally, the Centrum (5%) line is a dashed yellow line with diamond markers that remains relatively stable across the chart, beginning at roughly 15.8 at x=0, staying near 15.8 at x=16, and concluding at approximately 15.9 at x=64.
